I have a scar on my knee. My mom says she can't remember where I got it, maybe from falling. My dad says the following account sounds "vaguely familiar":

I was running around the church gymnasium during a pot-luck and after actual services. The church also had a school, so the gymnasium was also where a kitchen was, and the kitchen had a window between the gymnasium and the kitchen. Various church members were in the kitchen slicing up food-stuffs and handing them out the window to the people waiting on the gymnasium side to put on tables. I wanted to help, so I climbed up and sat on the little ledge in the window separating the two rooms, just in time for someone to turn around with a large knife and cut my knee.

Now, your child being stabbed at the church potluck is not something I would think my parents would have forgotten, and that window was fairly tall, so I'm not sure someone would be knife-wielding at that level, or with the knife far enough away from the body to cross the counter in front of the window and slice open a child's knee.

But in my mind, that shit totally happened.
